texts:
$25 in held $THREE turns on 200k-poly generation with PBR, and game-ready export for Unity and Unreal.

Holding, not spending, is the mechanism.

three.ws/three

$500 held takes 20% off all compute.

Draft and standard generation stay free whether you hold any or not. The hold is for the expensive lanes, not the front door.

issues.problem: The live page and the image both say "20% off all $THREE compute"; dropping "$THREE" broadens the discount to compute paid by any means. Literally defensible but slightly wider than the verified text.
issues.fix: Optionally tighten to "$500 held takes 20% off all $THREE compute." The post stays under 280 either way.

issues.problem: A first-time reader may not know what generation is being gated, though the link and image resolve it. Acceptable for the token lane audience.
issues.fix: No change required; if tightening anyway, "$25 in held $THREE turns on 200k-poly model generation with PBR" keeps the count under the band.

altText: A three.ws card reading 'Hold $THREE. Unlock the fast lanes.' beside a browser window showing the hold-to-access ladder: Bronze at $25 with high-quality 200k poly generation and game-ready export both badged LIVE, Silver at $100, Gold at $500 with 20% off compute, and Genesis at $2,500

editor.summary: Every claim ($25 Bronze gating 200k-poly/PBR and Unity/Unreal export, $500 Gold 20% compute discount, free draft/standard lanes) is verified against the live page, and the screenshot matches it including the LIVE badges. Voice, length, and media all conform; only optional tightening of "all compute" to "all $THREE compute" is suggested, so it ships as is.
